vars.instruction: This is a character design sheet of one character. Change only her outfit, identically in every full-body view and every face panel: (1) add a necklace: a thin dark cord with a small orange carrot pendant with a short green leafy top, resting just below the collar; (2) add plain white socks on both feet, ending just above the ankles, still with no shoes; (3) simplify the dress to a plain pink short-sleeved dress: a simple flared skirt falling to just below the knee with one plain ruffle at the hem edged with a thin red trim line, a plain bodice with a small ruffled collar; no layered petticoats, no lace, no polka dots, no white panels, no large bow. Keep her face, hair, ears, expressions, tail, poses, the sheet layout, the white sticker outlines and the background exactly as they are. In the colour swatch row, replace the last swatch with the carrot orange.

This is a character design sheet of one character. Make only two changes. (1) Her carrot necklace: lengthen the thin dark cord so it hangs loosely and naturally with gravity and the small orange carrot pendant rests lower, at mid-chest; the cord drapes softly and is not stiff, and in the three-quarter view it swings slightly to one side with her movement. Show the same longer necklace in every full-body view and every face panel where the chest is visible; in the back view, only the cord at the back of the neck shows, lying naturally under the hair. (2) In the back view, clean up the back of the neck: the hair, the cord and the dress collar meet cleanly with no stray marks, smudges or broken lines. Keep everything else exactly as it is: her face, hair, ears, expressions, dress, socks, tail, poses, the sheet layout, the white sticker outlines, the swatches and the background.

This is a character design sheet of one character. Change only the back view (the top-right full-body figure seen from behind), at the back of her neck: between the bottom edge of her short black hair and the back of the dress collar, show a small area of her smooth bare skin (the nape of her neck), in the same warm light skin tone as her arms, with the thin dark necklace cord crossing it naturally and disappearing under the hair at the sides. The collar lies flat and neat, with no carrot pendant, no knot and no stray marks at the back. Keep everything else exactly as it is, including every other figure, every face panel, the necklace in the front views, the swatches, the sticker outlines and the background.

vars.pose: both standing relaxed and facing the viewer, character 1 on the left with her ears standing upright and alert, character 2 on the right with her ears perked and one tilted mischievously

vars.instruction: Change only the taller character's rabbit ears (the one with long light-purple hair and the black blazer): make them floppier and softer, as in her classic look: still very long, white with pink-red insides and the two small button accessories at the base, but rumpled and creased, each ear bending over partway up so the upper half folds and droops loosely to the side, one ear slightly lower than the other, not standing stiff and straight. Keep the white sticker outline around the new ear shapes. Keep everything else exactly the same, including the other character, both faces, hair, outfits, poses, proportions, positions and the background.

Remove every human ear. These characters have only their rabbit ears on top of the head and no human ears at all: wherever a human ear is visible at the side of the head, in every full-body figure and every face panel, replace it with the character's own hair falling naturally over that spot, matching the surrounding hair colour, shading and line art. Keep everything else exactly the same: the rabbit ears, faces, expressions, hair style, outfits, poses, proportions, layout, colour swatches, white sticker outlines and the background.
